Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed three-slot virtual onsite for Sophie Zhang (backend) - please confirm

Hi all,

We have Sophie Zhang (backend, backend infra) scheduled for a full virtual loop next Wednesday. Kelly shared Sophie’s availability (attached) and asked if we can keep the loop compact (no more than 3 slots). Draft proposal below — times are PDT. Attachment: sophie_zhang_slots_v1.pdf

Proposed slots (all Zoom):
- 09:30 - 10:10 PDT: System design + architecture deep dive — owner: Jonas
- 10:20 - 10:50 PDT: Backend deep dive (data pipelines, reliability) — owner: Marissa
- 11:00 - 11:30 PDT: Team fit + behavioral + roadmap — owner: Laura

Quick asks:
- Can each interviewer confirm you can own the topic and be available at the slot above?
- We’ll ask interviewers to keep feedback to a single scorecard itemized by competence (design, implementation, ownership, communication).
- Senior IC hire — please flag if you need 40m instead of 30m.

Kelly / Sophie: can you confirm Sophie’s timezone is still PST and she can do an 11:30 end?

If no objections, I’ll lock the invites and drop the Greenhouse link.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Hiring Coordinator — Engineering Recruiting
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Irene. I can cover the backend deep dive, but I have a conflict at 10:20–10:50 (back-to-back with a cross-team sync) — I can do 09:50–10:20 or 11:00–11:30 if that helps.

Proposal from my side: swap the backend deep dive to 09:50–10:20 and move Jonas’s system design to 10:30–11:10 (extend by 10m). That keeps the loop compact but gives me room to grab the deep dive. If we extend Jonas by 10m (he’s good with 40m), we’ll finish ~11:10 and still leave a short team fit.

Also: quick note on feedback — I prefer we each jot one paragraph inline in Greenhouse and then pick top 3 rubric bullets in the debrief. I added a draft rubric here: https://drive.google.com/schedules/sophie-zhang-panel-matrix (see tab: "Rubric notes").

Thanks for the quick responses — final slotting below, locked and invites sent. I updated Greenhouse with the schedule and attached the final slot matrix (sophie_zhang_slots_v1.pdf).

Final schedule (PDT) — all Zoom rooms created and linked in the invites:
- 09:30 - 10:10 PDT: System design (Jonas) — Zoom room A (record off)
- 10:10 - 10:40 PDT: Backend deep dive (Marissa) — Zoom room B
- 10:40 - 11:10 PDT: Team fit + roadmap (Laura) — Zoom room B (quick wrap)

Notes and debrief logistics:
- We compressed slots slightly to respect Sophie’s end time. Please stick to the timeboxes so Sophie can make her later appointment.
- Debrief cadence: quick 10-minute huddle in Slack (#hiring-debrief) immediately after the loop — I’ll post a short template.
- Submit your scored rubric in Greenhouse within 2 hours. If you need to add technical notes, drop them in the "Interview notes" section and tag me.
- Recording: do NOT record. We only take written notes per policy.

Attachments: sophie_zhang_slots_v1.pdf (final), sophie_zhang_resume.pdf (candidate).

Thanks again — see you all Wed.
